requirements.description: Authenticated access with 5 demo accounts, role-based capabilities, and server-side authentication boundaries
Navigation across Dashboard, Accounts, Settlement, and Audit workspaces

Tiered fresh-per-cycle inclining blocks, TOU peak/shoulder/off-peak buckets with the mid-cycle rate change split by metered sub-period (half-open boundary on the new rate), and the RPS/SBC/GRT rider bases and strike order (RPS on gross energy, SBC on gross kWh, GRT last on the net-of-credit everything-else base)

A late/estimated read trued up and attributed back across accrual periods by stored baseline weight, each period re-billed on its own fresh blocks, the prior bill superseded (retained, not edited) and a contra of the energy-only delta posted

A SECOND, later correction on an already-corrected accrual period nets its contra against the CURRENT live re-bill (not the original estimate and not zero), and both generations of the superseded chain stay on file with their own figures intact

An over-threshold re-bill is held for a settlement controller's approval; the raising analyst's own approval attempt and an unauthenticated attempt are refused; a body-claimed approver identity, amount, or role on an otherwise-valid controller approval is ignored in favor of the signed-in session

The approved over-threshold re-bill's contra is the energy-only re-bill minus the energy-only prior bill, reproduced correctly and independently on two separate accounts, never bundled with the fixed charge or a rider surcharge

Export credit at the avoided-cost rate (not retail), an energy-only offset including the zero-bill boundary case, bank carryforward/drawdown summed from movement rows (never a stored scalar, never a spurious movement when no surplus exists), and RPS/SBC on the gross pre-credit basis with GRT on the net-of-credit basis

Per-cycle signed deferred movement, the deferred balance summed from movement rows, the annual true-up settling the balance and re-levelling to the trailing-12 actual, and the half-open enrollment-anniversary boundary refusing a not-yet-due account

The period remittance is the sum of the app's own persisted rider-accrual rows across exactly that period's finalized cycles (never a stored/echoed figure, never another period's rows), with duplicate-remit refusal
A duplicate bill request on an already-billed cycle is refused and mints nothing further, and a re-bill/true-up attempted against a finalized/remitted cycle is refused naming its locked status

SQLite durable persistence and re-derivation of the compounded catch-up chain, the dual-control contra, the net-metering bank, and the remittance figure across page reload and re-authentication; server-backed mutations
Theme switching, mobile-responsive layout, accessible semantic markup, and interactive feedback

functional_coverage_note: 11 functional criteria cover all 10 substantive business-logic requirement groups (REQ-ENERGY-COMPOSITION through REQ-IDEMPOTENCY-LOCK) beyond auth/workspace/persistence/polish scaffolding — 10 of 10 domain requirement groups (>80%) have at least one dedicated, self-contained functional criterion; REQ-AUTH, REQ-WORKSPACE and REQ-PERSISTENCE are additionally covered by render/constraints. Consolidated from the pre-v2 task's 26 single-leg criteria into 11 richer multi-leg criteria, preserving every original criterion's numeric pass bar inside one of these 11, plus one new compounding criterion (catchup_second_correction_compounds_on_same_account) not present in the pre-v2 set, and the dual-control criterion deliberately split in two (a clean auth/identity gate, kept undiluted, versus the still-broken contra computation) so a fix to one is never masked by the other. A v1.3.0 hardening pass (independent fresh-QC follow-up, utilibill-v2-hardening-2) closed a role-boundary coverage gap: a wrong-role/signed-out refusal leg was added for each of the five protected mutating actions that previously had none (bill, raise true-up, budget true-up, finalize, remit — approve already had one in dual_control_role_gate_and_forged_identity), placed inside energy_composition_tou_ratechange_and_riders, catchup_allocation_supersede_and_contra, budget_levelized_read_trueup_and_anniversary_boundary, remittance_sum_of_accruals, and cycle_billing_idempotency_and_remitted_lock respectively; the same pass added an audit-trail append-only tamper-refusal leg (cycle_billing_idempotency_and_remitted_lock) and a same-session net-metering bank-compounding leg on ACCT-C5's own second cycle CY-C5-J2/MR-C5-J2 (net_metering_credit_bank_and_gross_riders), so criteria now carry 1-5 legs apiece rather than a uniform 1-3. Every functional criterion places its own live fixture (or reads only shared seed data untouched by any other criterion, including CY-C5-J2/MR-C5-J2 added in the hardening pass) rather than depending on a fixture only the golden's own internal seed/bootstrap code could produce — none references state unreachable through the normal signed-in-user API surface, so nothing here can be structurally unsatisfiable for a non-golden submission.
